Ava (People Ops): quick heads-up — we've finished drafting a small handbook annex for data residency (affects teams that handle customer EU/UK data). doc: https://redwood.docs/internal/handbook/data-residency-addendum (please read the summary at top)
Keaton (Legal): skimmed — looks good overall. one wording tweak: replace "indefinitely stored" with "retained per retention schedule". i'll push a patch in the doc now.
Jules (Eng Manager): who needs to sign? managers only or ICs too?
Ava (People Ops): managers + any ICs with prod data access. contractors who are contractors-only (no prod data) will get a separate checkbox flow. we'll attach a CSV of scope after this thread.
Marta (People Ops EMEA): can we run two live training slots for EMEA folks? i can host 10:00 & 16:00 GMT next Tue/Wed. prefer Tue if enough people.
Ava (People Ops): planning calendar blocks now. signup form: https://forms.redwood/workplace/residency-training — please RSVP by EOD Fri. EMEA session: Tue 10:00 GMT; US session: Wed 9:00 PT.
Samir (Manager-NA): signed the doc, left a comment about shared S3 buckets. :white_check_mark:
hr-bot: Compliance task updated — Samir (Manager-NA) marked "Data residency addendum" complete. (compliance id: CR-2026-45)
Priya (Sales): will customer-facing sales folks need anything else (scripts or Q&A) to explain the change to customers?
Ava (People Ops): good q — short FAQ + 2-line email template coming. will drop into #customer-success and sales playbook later today.
Keaton (Legal): pushed the retention wording update. no other legal blockers. recommend managers confirm team lists before signoff.
Jules (Eng Manager): noted. i'll run a quick inventory and ping you if contractors need escalation.
Leo (People Ops Intern): attaching sample output for manager signoff export:
```
manager,team,signoff_ts,status
Samir,Payments,2813457801,complete
Jules,Search,2813459002,pending
```
Ava (People Ops): action items recapped:
• managers: review doc + e-sign by next Friday
• people-ops: finalize FAQ + email template (Ava, Leo)
• legal: confirm wording (Keaton)
• ops: inventory contractors with prod access (Jules)
I'll post a final reminder and upload the master CSV to the shared drive. thanks all :pray:
Marta (People Ops EMEA): i'll add the EMEA zoom links to the calendar invite and ping region leads.
Priya (Sales): RSVP'd for Wed US session. thanks!
hr-bot: Reminder scheduled — manager signoff deadline in 6 days (2813512789).
